title: Docker Stack Degradation RCA — 2026-05-20T04:32–20:06Z

root_cause.primary: Disk pressure (97% full) + RAG async startup lifespan handler hang
root_cause.trigger_event: docker compose up -d at 20:05:22Z with disk at 97% capacity
root_cause.mechanism: sentence-transformers embedding model initialization blocked by disk I/O contention during LanceDB (29GB) cold-load

blast_radius.cascade_explanation: RAG lifespan handler hung → api-gateway health check timeout → api-gateway marked unhealthy → other services appeared unreachable (no explicit depends_on chain, but health checks failed)

key_events.event: docker compose up -d triggered; all 9 services + frontend started simultaneously
RAG service began async startup; embedding model initialization started
System disk at 97% capacity; I/O throttling active
RAG healthcheck (30s start_period) timeout; still stuck in 'Waiting for application startup'
RAG container restarted; embedding model loaded successfully (2nd attempt, faster)
All 11 services UP and responding; stack healthy

disk_analysis.pressure_factor: LanceDB vector database (29GB) for RAG embeddings is the primary driver

reproducibility.conditions: Cold-start of all services when system disk ≥90% full
reproducibility.likelihood_current_state: low (disk usage varies; unlikely to hit 97% again)
reproducibility.likelihood_if_lancedb_grows: high (vector DB will grow with more PDF extractions)

hardening_recommendations.title: Disk space validation before docker-compose up
hardening_recommendations.description: Add bash script to fail fast if free disk < 15GB

hardening_recommendations.title: Increase RAG service start_period
hardening_recommendations.description: Bump docker-compose.yml rag-service start_period from 30s → 60s to account for disk I/O contention

hardening_recommendations.title: Pre-download embedding model in Dockerfile
hardening_recommendations.description: Add RUN step to apps/rag-service/Dockerfile to eagerly cache sentence-transformers model during build, avoiding first-run HF download

hardening_recommendations.title: LanceDB compaction and archival
hardening_recommendations.description: Implement daily/weekly cron job to compact LanceDB, archive old embeddings, or vacuum to reclaim disk

hardening_recommendations.title: Disk usage alerting
hardening_recommendations.description: Monitor /app/data/lancedb size; alert when > 20GB (threshold lower than current 29GB to give headroom)

hardening_recommendations.title: Async-ify RAG lifespan handler
hardening_recommendations.description: Move sentence-transformers model loading to thread pool or async context to avoid blocking FastAPI startup

recovery_action_taken.method: Manual docker restart of RAG container
recovery_action_taken.notes: 2nd attempt succeeded faster (likely due to model cache hit or temporary disk pressure relief)

impact.user_facing: backend unavailable for ~1 min during degradation; frontend could not fetch data

next_steps: Implement 1958-watchdog-3 (pre-cache embedding model) — medium effort, reduces cold-start risk
Design 1958-watchdog-4 (LanceDB management strategy) — requires data retention policy discussion with PM
Activate disk monitoring (1958-watchdog-5) in alerting system
